yt_quota_exhausted: YouTube API quota for today is used up (reads stop at 90% to keep a reserve for replies). It resets at midnight Pacific Time.
yt_quota_write_blocked: The YouTube API quota for today is used up; replies and moderation are possible again after midnight Pacific Time.
yt_client_id_invalid: The client ID must look like 1234567890-abc123.apps.googleusercontent.com (OAuth client of type "Desktop app").
yt_client_secret_short: The client secret looks too short. Copy it from the OAuth client in Google Cloud Console.
yt_client_missing: Save your Google OAuth client ID and secret first.
yt_no_channel: This Google account has no YouTube channel. Pick a channel (or brand account) on Google's consent screen.
yt_connect_denied: Access was not granted on Google's consent screen.
yt_connect_timeout: Sign-in timed out. Start "Connect channel" again.
yt_not_connected: This YouTube channel is not connected.
yt_stale_data: YouTube data of {name} has not been refreshed for {days} days. Sync it, or disconnect and delete its data (YouTube API policy).
yt_reply_scope_missing: Replying on YouTube needs extra permission. Use "Enable replying" for this channel in Settings → Connections.
yt_reply_too_long: YouTube replies can be at most {n} characters.
yt_report_note: YouTube Analytics data arrives with a 2–3 day delay; the last days of the period may still change.
